gen-dafont-dogica-gf-radio-canada-big: Dogica stamps down heavy, wide-spaced letters whose lowercase climbs nearly to capital height. And Radio Canada Big follows with one steady line, terminals pulled clear of the stems, like bent pipe.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro reads quietly, with broad gaps at its terminals and a weight that never wavers from word to word. Dogica is the loud one here, heavy and widely spaced.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-ruda: Ruda keeps a wire-like line with a sizable x-height, and no hairlines to squint at. Ruda would carry a long passage gently, while Dogica stays the heavy, wide-spaced voice above it.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-saira: Wide tracking and a lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals give Dogica its weight. Saira would read smoothly over a long passage, its rounded letters stretching high and each s showing a gap you can see through.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-sarpanch: Blunt, wide, a bit stubborn. Dogica does heavy and commanding best, while Sarpanch handles the quieter work, its open-mouthed e and compact ascender gap keeping text approachable.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Commanding is how Dogica comes across, heavy and wide-tracked with curves left open at their ends. And Schibsted Grotesk keeps things approachable below, though shrinking the heading would blunt that weight.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-sen: Heavy, wide, unmistakably blocky. Sen draws tall lowercase with curves as thick as its straight stems, and that modern uniformity against Dogica's weight is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-sintony: Sintony brings a chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves. Dogica is best at heavy, wide-spaced impact, whereas Sintony does its best work being easy on the eye in running text.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-sofia-sans: Wide tracking and an opening at the end of every curve make Dogica instantly recognizable. Sofia Sans answers its weight with tall, modulation-free rounds, modern and quiet.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-sofia-sans-semi-con: Dogica's lowercase rises almost to capital height, spaced out wide and heavy. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed slips in beside it with round letters like bent wire, so the page moves from blunt weight to a lean, stencil-cut line.
